**What does this project do, and why does it belong on the list?**



**Checklist**

- [ ] I read the [contribution guidelines](../contributing.md)
- [ ] This PR adds/changes **one** entry
- [ ] The entry is in the correct section, in alphabetical order
- [ ] Format is `- [Name](link) - Description.` (capital start, period end, ~110 chars max)
- [ ] The link works and points to the project's repository (or paper/model card if no repo)
- [ ] The project is open, documented, and maintained (or clearly marked archived/seminal)
- [ ] PR title is `Add <Project Name>` (or `Fix/Remove <Project Name>`)
